name: Accordion
summary: Stacked headings that each reveal a section, with single or multiple open items.

name: ActionMenu
summary: A compact “more actions” menu built from an array, ideal for table rows and cards.

name: AIGeneratedLabel
summary: A small label that marks content as generated, assisted or edited by AI, with an optional model name.

name: AlertDialog
summary: An interruptive dialog that asks the user to confirm or cancel an important action.

name: Alert
summary: An inline message about the state of a page or section, in four tones.

name: AspectRatio
summary: Holds images, video and embeds to a fixed width-to-height ratio so layouts never shift.

name: AttachmentTray
summary: The files and images attached to a draft or a sent message, with upload progress, errors and a remove button on each.

name: AvatarGroup
summary: A stack of overlapping avatars with a "+N" overflow, announced as a list.

name: Avatar
summary: A person or organisation shown as an image or initials, with optional presence.

name: Badge
summary: A short, non-interactive status or count label in six tones and three variants.

name: Banner
summary: A full-width, page-level announcement such as maintenance windows or plan limits.

name: Box
summary: The lowest-level layout primitive: padding, surface, border, radius and shadow from tokens.

name: BranchSwitcher
summary: Steps between alternative versions of a message after an edit or a retry, and shows which one is on screen.

name: Breadcrumbs
summary: Shows where the current page sits in a hierarchy and links back up it.

name: ButtonGroup
summary: Groups related buttons, either joined into a segmented bar or evenly spaced.

name: Button
summary: Triggers an action, with six variants, four sizes and a loading state.

name: Calendar
summary: A keyboard-accessible month grid for choosing a date or a date range.

name: Caption
summary: Small supporting text for figures, timestamps and footnotes.

name: Card
summary: A contained surface for related content, with header, media, content and footer parts.

name: ChartContainer
summary: An accessible chart frame with title, legend, responsive sizing and a data-table alternative.

name: CheckboxGroup
summary: A labelled set of checkboxes that share one array value.

name: Checkbox
summary: A native checkbox with label, description and an indeterminate state.

name: Chip
summary: A selectable toggle chip for quick filters and choices.

name: CitationChip
summary: An inline numbered marker that links a claim to its source and previews it on hover, focus or tap.

name: CodeBlock
summary: A multi-line code sample with title, line numbers, highlighting and copy.

name: Code
summary: Inline code for identifiers, values and file names in running text.

name: Collapsible
summary: A single disclosure: one trigger shows and hides one region.

name: Combobox
summary: An editable input with a filtered list of suggestions, supporting async search and custom values.

name: CommandMenu
summary: A searchable, keyboard-driven list of commands with groups, keywords and shortcuts.

name: CommandPalette
summary: A global ⌘K / Ctrl+K command menu in a dialog for fast navigation and actions.

name: ConfidenceBadge
summary: States how sure the system is about an answer in plain words, with a distinct icon for each level.

name: ConfirmationDialog
summary: A ready-made confirm/cancel dialog with async loading and error handling, plus an imperative useConfirm() hook.

name: Container
summary: Centres page content with a maximum width and responsive gutters.

name: ContextChips
summary: Chips that show what the assistant can see for a message, such as files, pages or selections, each one removable.

name: ContextMenu
summary: A menu that opens at the pointer on right-click, long-press, Shift+F10 or the Menu key.

name: ConversationList
summary: A list of past conversations grouped by date, with selection, inline rename, delete and pin.

name: CopyButton
summary: Copies text to the clipboard and confirms it visually and to screen readers.

name: CopyableCode
summary: One line of code with a copy button, for commands, keys and IDs.

name: DataGrid
summary: A spreadsheet-style grid with cell navigation, in-place editing, resizable columns and virtualised rows.

name: DataTable
summary: A table for records with sorting, row selection, pagination, loading and empty states.

name: DatePicker
summary: A date field people can type into or fill from a calendar popover.

name: DateRangePicker
summary: Picks a start and end date from a two-month calendar, with optional preset ranges.

name: DescriptionList
summary: Key to value pairs such as account details or contract metadata, using native <dl>.

name: Dialog
summary: A modal window for focused tasks that must be finished or dismissed before returning to the page.

name: DisclaimerNote
summary: A quiet note under the composer or a response, such as a reminder to check important facts.

name: Divider
summary: Separates sections of content, optionally with a short label such as “or”.

name: Drawer
summary: A modal panel that slides in from a screen edge for details, filters and secondary tasks.

name: DropdownMenu
summary: A menu of actions or options opened from a button, with groups, checkable items and submenus.

name: EmptyState
summary: Explains why an area is empty and offers the next step.

name: ErrorBoundary
summary: Catches rendering errors in part of the screen and shows a recoverable fallback.

name: FeedbackBar
summary: Thumbs up or down on a response, followed by optional reasons and a comment, then a thank you.

name: FileTree
summary: A TreeView preset for folders and files, with open and closed folder icons.

name: FileUpload
summary: Choose files by browsing or drag and drop, with type, size and count validation.

name: FilterBar
summary: A responsive row of search, filters, results count and "Clear all".

name: FilterChip
summary: A filter control showing its name and current value, editable in a popover.

name: FloatingActionButton
summary: The primary action of a screen, floating above content in a corner.

name: FormField
summary: Wires a label, help text and error message to any Stance form control.

name: GenerationProgress
summary: Progress for longer generations such as images or documents, with a stage label and a way to cancel.

name: Grid
summary: Two-dimensional layout with fixed columns that collapse responsively, or fluid auto-fit tracks.

name: Heading
summary: Section headings with a semantic level and an independent visual size.

name: HoverCard
summary: A rich preview that appears when hovering or focusing a link.

name: IconButton
summary: A compact button that shows only an icon and always carries an accessible label.

name: IconGallery
summary: A searchable grid of every Stance icon; choose one to copy its name.

name: Icon
summary: Original Stance icons as inline SVG that inherit the current text colour.

name: Image
summary: An image with lazy loading, a reserved ratio and a graceful fallback.

name: InlineEdit
summary: Text that can be edited in place: activate it to type, press Enter to save or Escape to cancel.

name: Inline
summary: Lays children out horizontally and wraps them, for tags, actions and metadata.

name: Input
summary: A single-line text field with sizes, affixes and validation states.

name: InterruptedState
summary: Marks a response that was stopped or failed part way, and offers to try again or continue.

name: Kbd
summary: Displays a keyboard key or shortcut with spoken labels for symbols.

name: Label
summary: A form label with required and optional indicators.

name: Link
summary: Navigates to another page or resource, inline in text or on its own.

name: ListItem
summary: A list row with leading media, title, description, metadata and actions.

name: List
summary: A semantic list of related items with dividers, density and an optional bordered surface.

name: LoadingOverlay
summary: Covers a region or the whole screen with a spinner while work is in progress.

name: MentionPicker
summary: A filterable list that opens from a trigger character in the composer, to reference files, people or tools by name.

name: Menubar
summary: A persistent bar of menus for editor-style applications, as in File, Edit and View.

name: MessageActions
summary: The row of actions under a message: copy, try again, edit, good response and bad response, plus any of your own.

name: MessageGroup
summary: Consecutive messages from one author under a single avatar and name, so a long exchange stays easy to scan.

name: Message
summary: One turn in a conversation from the user, the assistant or the system, with slots for an avatar, actions and a footer.

name: ModelPicker
summary: A compact select for choosing which model answers the next message, with a short description and capability badges on each option.

name: MultiSelect
summary: Choose several values; selections appear as removable tags and the list stays open while you pick.

name: NativeSelect
summary: A styled native <select> for simple choices and long lists.

name: NavigationMenu
summary: Site or product navigation with optional flyout panels of links, using the disclosure pattern.

name: Notification
summary: Notification items and a ready-made notification center with unread state and mark-as-read.

name: NumberInput
summary: Numeric entry with stepper buttons and full spinbutton keyboard support.

name: Pagination
summary: Accessible page navigation for long lists and tables, with previous, next and compact modes.

name: PasswordInput
summary: Password entry with a show/hide toggle and an optional strength meter.

name: PinInput
summary: A one-time code or PIN field split into cells, with paste, SMS autofill and full keyboard support.

name: Popover
summary: Non-modal floating content anchored to a trigger, for small forms, filters and details.

name: ProgressCircle
summary: A circular progress indicator, determinate or indeterminate.

name: Progress
summary: A linear progress bar for uploads, deployments and multi-step tasks.

name: PromptComposer
summary: The message input for a conversation: a text area that grows as people type, with slots for attachments and tools, and a send button that becomes stop.

name: RadioGroup
summary: A labelled set of mutually exclusive options, with list and card layouts.

name: RangeSlider
summary: Select a minimum and maximum with two thumbs that cannot cross.

name: ReasoningDisclosure
summary: A collapsible block for the reasoning behind an answer: open while thinking and a short summary when done.

name: ReportDialog
summary: A dialog to report an AI response, with a category to choose and room for details.

name: ResizablePanel
summary: One resizable region inside a SplitPanel, with size limits and optional collapse.

name: RichText
summary: Typographic rhythm for long-form content: legal pages, help articles, MDX.

name: ScrollArea
summary: A native scroll container with thin themed scrollbars, edge fades and keyboard access.

name: ScrollToLatest
summary: A floating button that appears when the reader has scrolled away from the newest message and takes them back.

name: SearchInput
summary: A search field with a clear button, Escape to clear and an optional shortcut hint.

name: SearchableList
summary: A search field paired with a filtered list, with result counts announced as you type.

name: Select
summary: Choose one value from a list, with typeahead, groups, disabled options and form submission.

name: SensitiveContentGate
summary: Hides content behind a short notice until the reader chooses to see it, then moves focus to it.

name: Separator
summary: A thin rule between groups in menus, toolbars and lists.

name: Sheet
summary: A bottom sheet for mobile-first flows, with a drag handle to dismiss.

name: ShimmerText
summary: Text with a slow light sweep for labels of work in progress, such as Searching the web.

name: Sidebar
summary: Composable primitives for application sidebar navigation, with an icon-only collapsed mode.

name: SignaturePad
summary: Captures a hand-drawn signature with pointer, touch or stylus, with undo, clear and form submission.

name: Skeleton
summary: Placeholder shapes that hold the layout while content loads.

name: SkipLink
summary: Lets keyboard users jump past navigation to the main content.

name: SlashCommandMenu
summary: A list of commands that opens when a draft starts with a slash, filtered as people type and chosen without leaving the text area.

name: Slider
summary: Pick a single value from a range by dragging or with the keyboard.

name: SortableList
summary: A list people can reorder by dragging, with the keyboard, or with move buttons, announcing every change.

name: SourceList
summary: The sources behind an answer, shown as a compact row of sites that expands to a full numbered list.

name: SourcePreview
summary: A card for one source behind an answer: its title, site, a short snippet and a link to open it.

name: Spacer
summary: Adds a fixed gap from the scale, or flexes to push siblings apart.

name: Spinner
summary: An indeterminate loading indicator with an accessible status label.

name: SplitButton
summary: A primary action joined to a menu of closely related alternatives.

name: SplitPanel
summary: A group of resizable panels separated by draggable, keyboard-accessible handles.

name: Stack
summary: Arranges children in a vertical or horizontal flow with consistent, token-based spacing.

name: StatCard
summary: A single key metric with its change, period and an optional chart.

name: Stepper
summary: Shows progress through an ordered, multi-step task.

name: StopButton
summary: A button that stops a response while it is being generated, as text with a stop mark or as the mark alone.

name: StreamingSkeleton
summary: Placeholder lines for a response that has been requested and has not started to arrive.

name: StreamingText
summary: Reveals text at a steady pace as it arrives, with an optional caret, and never animates what is already on screen.

name: Switch
summary: An on/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately.

name: TabBar
summary: A mobile navigation bar for three to five top-level destinations.

name: Table
summary: Semantic table primitives with density, striping, sticky headers, sorting and accessible row links.

name: Tabs
summary: Switches between related panels of content within the same page.

name: Tag
summary: A compact keyword label for categories and filters, with an optional accessible remove button.

name: Text
summary: Body copy with size, weight and semantic tone from the type scale.

name: Textarea
summary: Multi-line text entry with optional auto-resize and a character counter.

name: ThemeProvider
summary: Owns the appearance: light, dark, high contrast or system, persisted with no flash on load.

name: ThemeSwitcher
summary: A segmented control that lets people choose light, dark, high contrast or system.

name: ThinkingIndicator
summary: Shows that the assistant is working before any text arrives, with a label and optional elapsed time.

name: ThreadEmptyState
summary: The opening screen of a new conversation, with a greeting and starter prompts that show what the assistant can do.

name: Thread
summary: The scrolling container for a conversation. It follows the latest message while the reader is at the bottom and lets go when they scroll up.

name: TimePicker
summary: Enter a time of day with keyboard-friendly hour and minute segments.

name: Timeline
summary: A chronological list of events, such as an audit trail or deployment history.

name: Toast
summary: Brief, non-blocking messages about the result of an action, with optional Undo.

name: ToggleButton
summary: A button that stays pressed, alone or in a group with single or multiple selection.

name: TokenBudgetMeter
summary: A compact meter of how much of the context or message limit is used, with a warning in words as the limit gets close.

name: Toolbar
summary: Groups related controls into one tab stop with arrow-key navigation.

name: Tooltip
summary: A short text label that appears on hover and keyboard focus.

name: TreeView
summary: Displays and navigates hierarchical data with expandable branches.

name: VirtualizedList
summary: Renders very long lists efficiently by mounting only the visible window of items.

name: VoiceInputButton
summary: A microphone button for dictating a message, with idle, listening and processing states and a ring that follows the input level.
